tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per attached tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have executed supply of furniture worth Rs.40 Lakhs , in a single or multiple projects during the last 3 years.
Company Information shall be furnished as per - Annexure-3. Bidder/Manufacturer who have a head office/Regional office in Mangaluru are preferred
The End of Life of the Products quoted/supplied shall be a minimum of 3 years. The Manufacturer should give an undertaking to this effect.
All product and accessories should have Manufacturer warranty of minimum 2 years, the letter from Manufacturer on their letter head confirming to this should be attached with the tender.

Undertaking by participant/Bidder in pursuance to Govt. Circular on Border Country and sharing- vide circular no: FD 455 Exp-12/2020, Dated: 10.03.2021, where clarifications issued by the office Memorandum No:F.18/37/2020-PPO, Dtd: 08.02.2021
Undertaking - Annexure - III of the Government of Karnataka G.O No. FD-455 EXP-12, 2020 Bengaluru, dated 01.04.2023
The Bidder should have an annual turnover of a minimum average of 40 Lakhs in the last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26
